description: This PHP source file defines a function 'additionalDetailsUser' that generates an HTML snippet displaying detailed information about a user, including their name, title, department, phone numbers, and email, formatted with labels. It also constructs links for editing and viewing the user record. The file includes license and meta-information comments, with a check for valid entry point via 'sugarEntry' constant.

methods.name: additionalDetailsUser
methods.description: Generates user detail HTML snippet based on provided fields, incorporates localization strings and theme data, and constructs URLs for editing/viewing the user record.
